description: Sustainability standards PB methodology v3.5 recognises as credible for data-centre assets under FCA PS23/16 sustainability labels. PS23/16 requires standards to be 'robust' but does not enumerate them; this list is PB's calibration. Refresh on each methodology version bump if recognised set changes.

credible_standards.standard: EU Taxonomy Activity 8.1 (data processing, hosting and related activities) alignment
credible_standards.rationale: EU Taxonomy provides robust, sector-specific technical screening criteria (PUE, renewable energy, DNSH). Single most rigorous data-centre sustainability standard in force.

credible_standards.standard: LEED Platinum with Energy & Atmosphere prerequisites met
credible_standards.rationale: LEED Platinum certification with E&A prerequisites is widely recognised in the data-centre sector; meets PS23/16 'robust' bar for Focus label.

SBTi validation provides credible emissions reduction trajectory; suitable for Improvers (trajectory-based label) and Impact (additionality evidence). Does not cover full sustainability profile, so partial standing for Focus.

data_centre_kpis.rationale: Thresholds mirror EU Taxonomy 8.1 / CNDCP cool-warm split; Impact tier uses PB-conservatism aligned-tier values per methodology v3.5 F3.
Focus = 70% (PB methodology, harmonised with industry baseline). Impact tier = 80% with additionality evidence.

data_centre_kpis.unit: tonnes CO2e per MW per year
data_centre_kpis.rationale: PB methodology values; calibrated to industry top-quartile (Focus) and IEA NZE-2050 compatible trajectory (Impact).
Thresholds mirror EU Taxonomy 8.1 DNSH (water) gates. Impact tier requires single tight threshold + ≥50% water recycling.
